definitions.explanation: The point at which rays of light converge after passing through a lens or reflecting from a mirror. A technical term in optics and photography.

definitions.gloss: focus, central point (of attention or discussion)
definitions.explanation: The main point of attention, discussion, or concern. The most common usage in everyday language.

⟦レンズ→レンズ：07808_renzu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{焦点|しょうてん}⟦{距離|きょり}→距離：05331_kyori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧ほど{遠|とお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もの⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{撮|と}れる→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
examples.english: The longer the focal length of the lens, the larger you can photograph distant objects.

examples.english: If you focus sunlight to the focal point with a magnifying glass, the paper will burn.

examples.english: In the trial, the defendant's motive has become the focal point.

notes:
USAGE:
The figurative sense (focus of attention) is far more common in everyday language than the optical sense. The expression {焦点|しょうてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧ works for both senses — literally focusing a lens or figuratively directing attention.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {焦点|しょうてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧: to focus, to bring into focus
- {焦点|しょうてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{当|あ}てる→当てる：01864_ateru⟧: to focus on, to spotlight
- {焦点|しょうてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ずれる→ずれる：03370_zureru⟧: to be off focus, to lose focus
- {焦点|しょうてん}⟦{距離|きょり}→距離：05331_kyori⟧: focal length
- ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{焦点|しょうてん}: the focus of discussion
